lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged posterior to the branchial region. At least four distinct rows are visible, creating a staggered grid pattern with local maxima spaced roughly equidistant within rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the circular spots to form a lattice of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral flank, each exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and lower intensity/shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of small, circular high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily toward the anterior and middle sections of the fin's surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal cranial region and the proximal surface of the pectoral fin exhibit a significantly higher density of smaller, lower-magnitude high-luminance points compared to the mid-lateral flank.
